title: Shifting border
description: A softly colored gradient shifts around the edge of a quiet card.
useCase: Accent a featured card, release note or short editorial message.
reducedMotion: The border becomes a stationary gradient.
limitations: CSS mask-composite support is required for the border effect. Background-position animation repaints; keep the accent small.
look: Blank off-white rounded card on a warm greige page, its thin border tinted with soft peach, mauve and lavender that fades to grey.
motion: A 300% radial gradient masked to a 1.5 px border ring pans diagonally back and forth via background-position, completing an 8 s linear loop, so colour drifts around the edge.
adapt: The effect is `.mg-shine-border`: a `radial-gradient` at `background-size:300% 300%`, clipped to its padding ring by `mask-composite:exclude` and animated by `@keyframes mg-shine-position` over `8s`. Change the gradient stops and `padding:1.5px` (border width); put content inside `.mg-shine-card`.
